action.command:
python3 << 'PYEOF'
import re

path = "scripts/quality/provision-test-schema.sh"
with open(path) as f:
    content = f.read()

# Make the FK constraint fixes section idempotent by wrapping DROP+CREATE in DO blocks
# that only execute if the table exists AND has wrong FK references
old_section = """echo "=== FK constraint fixes"
DATABASE_URL="$prisma_url" pnpm exec prisma db execute --stdin <<'SQL'
DROP TABLE IF EXISTS exercise.exercise_attempt CASCADE;
CREATE TABLE exercise.exercise_attempt ("""

new_section = """echo "=== FK constraint fixes"
# Idempotent: only recreate tables if FK references are stale (post-schema-move).
# Safe for disposable test DBs; never run against shared/production databases.
DATABASE_URL="$prisma_url" pnpm exec prisma db execute --stdin <<'SQL'
DO $$ BEGIN
  IF EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM information_schema.table_constraints tc
    JOIN information_schema.constraint_column_usage ccu ON tc.constraint_name = ccu.constraint_name
    WHERE tc.table_schema = 'exercise' AND tc.table_name = 'exercise_attempt'
      AND tc.constraint_type = 'FOREIGN KEY'
      AND ccu.table_schema != 'exercise'
  ) THEN
    DROP TABLE exercise.exercise_attempt CASCADE;
  END IF;
END $$;
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS exercise.exercise_attempt ("""

content = content.replace(old_section, new_section)

# Fix bjt_question similarly
old_bjt = """DROP TABLE IF EXISTS assessment.bjt_question CASCADE;
CREATE TABLE assessment.bjt_question ("""
new_bjt = """DO $$ BEGIN
  IF EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM information_schema.table_constraints tc
    JOIN information_schema.constraint_column_usage ccu ON tc.constraint_name = ccu.constraint_name
    WHERE tc.table_schema = 'assessment' AND tc.table_name = 'bjt_question'
      AND tc.constraint_type = 'FOREIGN KEY'
      AND ccu.table_schema != 'assessment'
  ) THEN
    DROP TABLE assessment.bjt_question CASCADE;
  END IF;
END $$;
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS assessment.bjt_question ("""
content = content.replace(old_bjt, new_bjt)

# Remove the dangling DROP TABLE IF EXISTS learner.exercise_session CASCADE
# (it was a no-op after schema move; replace with a comment)
old_dangling = "DROP TABLE IF EXISTS learner.exercise_session CASCADE;"
new_dangling = "-- learner.exercise_session moved to exercise schema; no action needed."
content = content.replace(old_dangling, new_dangling)

with open(path, "w") as f:
    f.write(content)

print("PROVISION_SCRIPT_FIXED")
PYEOF
